description: Large hard-stop linear, radial, and conic gradients each paint directly on a transformed box and through a transformed ancestor. A page-axis-anchored PDF pattern produces unmistakably rotated color boundaries even when the box clip and border transform correctly.
Interaction: absolute child resolves top/left against the padding box of a padded positioned ancestor.
Interaction: an absolutely positioned child of a flex container is out of flow and positions against the flex container's padding box while in-flow flex items are spaced by justify-content.
flex-wrap pushes the fifth item to a new row; gap must apply both between items in a row and between the wrapped rows, with no gap on outer edges.
A grid container (2x2 cells) nested inside a flex item; the flex layout sizes the item and the grid lays out its cells within it.
Interaction: a left float beside in-flow blocks whose adjacent vertical margins collapse.
A left-floated box beside two stacked blocks whose adjacent vertical margins collapse to the larger value rather than summing.
Each cell of a 2x2 grid is filled with a horizontal linear gradient; grid sizing places the cells while the gradient paints across each cell box.
A flex container (space-between row) nested inside the first grid cell; grid places the cells and the flex distributes three boxes inside one of them.
Two inline-block boxes on a text line, one aligned to the baseline and one to the middle of the line box, sitting next to short text.
Interaction: object-fit:cover image content is clipped by a rounded overflow:hidden ancestor; catches square image corners escaping the ancestor clip.
Interaction: overflow:hidden clips a child after transform:translate moves it partly outside the container; catches clipping before transforms or leaking transformed visual overflow.
Interaction: overflow:hidden combined with border-radius clips the overflowing child to the rounded corners.
A rounded container with overflow:hidden clips a square filled child to its rounded corners, cutting away the child's corners.
A definite outer height propagates so a chain of percentage-height nested blocks each resolve against their parent (240 -> 120 -> 60).
Interaction: absolute percentage insets resolve inside a transformed containing block, not the page; catches wrong percentage bases or missing transform containing-block behavior.
Interaction: an absolutely positioned box that is also rotated; position resolves first, then transform rotates about its center.
Interaction: a fixed-position box that is then translated by a transform; position resolves against the page box, then translate shifts it.
Interaction: position:relative offset applied to a middle inline-block; its in-flow inline slot is preserved.
An absolutely-positioned child pinned to a corner of a relatively-positioned flex container, taken out of flow while the flex items lay out normally.
An absolutely-positioned child offset from a corner of a relatively-positioned grid container, removed from grid placement while the cells lay out.
Interaction: @supports(display:flow-root) must both query true and lay out flow-root float containment before the following red block; catches query-only support without layout.
A bordered 2x2 table laid out inside a flex item; the flex layout sizes the item around the table's intrinsic grid.
A bordered table whose thead cells use bold typography; table cell layout coexists with the heavier glyph weight in the header row.
Interaction: transform-box:border-box makes translateX(100%) resolve against the padded, bordered border box; catches content-box or parent-width percentage bases.
A rotate transform on the middle flex item is purely visual and must not change flex layout; the third item keeps its untransformed slot.

A Cartesian matrix composes rotate, non-uniform scale, skew, and compound transforms with regular, synthetic bold, synthetic oblique, and synthetic bold-oblique text. The standards-derived reference materializes CSS Fonts 4's required 20deg glyph-local shear because Chromium print substitutes its default italic synthesis, then composes each outer transform normally. Catches text-matrix shear or synthetic-weight behavior that changes sign, origin, or paint order only inside a transformed graphics state.
Interaction: z-index stacking where the upper positioned box carries a linear-gradient background over a lower solid box.
Three overlapping positioned boxes where a rotated, transformed high-z box must paint on top of the lower-z plain positioned boxes.

reference.note: CSS Fragmentation 3 section 5.4 requires box-decoration-break:slice to render the unbroken box and then slice it, with no box-shadow drawn at a broken edge. WPT box-shadow-002 tests that rule directly, while box-shadow-005 reserves a shadow around every fragment for box-decoration-break:clone. Ironpress leaves the page 2/3 cut undecorated; Chromium paints the yellow inset-shadow band at both cut edges as if the fragments were cloned. Its PDF remains a compatibility canary, not a normative oracle, and the raw shared-pdftoppm evidence remains reported.
